We love this whiteboard! We mounted it in our home office, which has recently turned into a home gym and preschool room for our young children due to COVID. The board arrived on time per the scheduled delivery and was really easy to unpack and mount despite its size. It did have a small dent in the side and a little scratch on the whiteboard face, but nothing that warrants sending back or replacing. As someone who has worked full time from home for years, I'm not sure how I managed before - this thing is awesome!!
It comes with everything needed to hang, although we added some command strips to ensure it stays in place since we have very young (almost 3 and almost 1) and very curious children. It also comes with two dry erase markers that attach to a magnetic eraser, a very small tray, and a few small magnets. Just make sure you measure before buying to guarantee you have the wall space.
I have owned my share of dry erase boards and this has been my best one yet!

If you're looking for a good whiteboard that is easy to write on and easy to wall mount then this product offers great value as long as you can look past some issues.

Pros: Easy mounting system, great magnetism, smooth markers, included 6 magnets

Cons: Included eraser is not very good, poor packaging that can lead to dents, bends, or tears in the metal frame (mine came with a small tear in the frame)

This white board arrived just as expected. We placed it in our basement office. My husband decided to not mount it to the wall but rather just placing it on the floor against the wall, because this way I the height works well for our little kids. We love the magnetic dry erase markers and everything that came with it. It is a complete set and works perfectly! My 3 years old can go there and just keeps drawing for hours. It is a must have for a homeschooling family!
